wechat.noAccount: No Official Account yet. Add one under "WeChat → Official Accounts" first
wechatAccount.name: Name
wechatAccount.token.tooltip: Must match the Token under "My Business - Official Account / Service Account - Basic Info - Domain & Message Push Settings - Message Push" on the WeChat Developer Platform; used to verify message callback signatures
wechatAccount.aesKey.tooltip: Must match the EncodingAESKey in the message push settings on the WeChat Developer Platform (43 characters). Required when the message encryption mode is "Compatible" or "Safe"
wechatAccount.logRetentionDays.tooltip: Message records and template message send records older than this are deleted by the daily cleanup task. 0 keeps them forever. Mass broadcast records and push records are not cleaned up
wechatAccount.callbackUrl.tooltip: Enter this address as the URL in the message push settings on the WeChat Developer Platform. WeChat servers must be able to reach this site
wechatAccount.stylePreset.tooltip: Adds inline styles to body elements when pushing articles. WeChat discards the site's style sheets; without this, articles are shown in WeChat's default typesetting. Only affects content pushed to the Official Account, not this site
wechatAccount.styleRules.tooltip: Each rule is "{'selector { styles }'}", applied after the preset and able to override it; an element's own inline styles take priority. /* comments */ are supported; nesting and {'@'} rules are not. Click "Preview typesetting" to check before saving
wechatAccount.style.problems: The following rules cannot be parsed and will be rejected on save:
wechatArticle.title: Title
wechatArticle.publishTip: When enabled, the draft is submitted for publishing as soon as the push succeeds. Publishing only generates a permanent link for the article (usable in custom menus and auto replies); it does not appear on the account's homepage and fans are not notified. To show it to fans, broadcast the draft under "Mass Broadcasts".
wechatArticle.publishConfirm: After publishing, the article gets a permanent link but does not appear on the account's homepage and fans are not notified. To show it to fans, broadcast the draft under "Mass Broadcasts". Publish now?
wechatArticle.pushTip: The article will be pushed to the Official Account's drafts. It must be published and have a cover image; images in the body are uploaded to WeChat automatically.
wechatArticle.push.orderTip: Multiple articles are combined into one multi-article message; drag to reorder, the first is the headline; up to {max} articles
wechatArticle.push.headline: Headline
wechatArticle.push.tooMany: A multi-article message holds at most {max} articles; remove the extra ones
wechatArticle.push.ineligible: Remove articles that are unpublished or have no cover
wechatArticle.preview.digestTip: The digest is shown only on the article card, not on the article page
wechatArticle.push.title: Title
wechatArticle.push.author: Author
wechatArticle.push.digest.headlineOnly: A multi-article message shows only the headline's digest
wechatArticle.push.cover.none: The article has no usable cover image
wechatArticle.push.overrideTip: Changes here apply to this push only and do not modify the article itself
wechatMaterial.name: File name
wechatMaterial.tip.image: Supports {formats}; each file up to {size}; multiple files can be selected at once. The file name becomes the material name and cannot be changed after upload
wechatMaterial.tip.voice: Supports {formats}; each file up to {size} and 60 s at most; multiple files can be selected at once. The file name becomes the material name and cannot be changed after upload
wechatMaterial.tip.video: Supports {formats}; file up to {size}; one video per upload. The video title becomes the material name and cannot be changed after upload; the description is stored in WeChat and cannot be read back through the API, so keep your own copy
wechatMaterial.newsTip: Articles cannot be uploaded here. Use "Push to WeChat" on a published article under "Content → Article", or create them on the WeChat Official Account Platform; the generated article is saved in "Drafts" and can be published from there. Only permanent article materials already in WeChat are listed here.
wechatMaterial.videoDescriptionUnavailab: The WeChat API did not return a description
wechatDraft.tip: Drafts are created by "Article → Push to WeChat" or on the WeChat Official Account Platform; here they can be published or deleted. Publishing only generates a permanent link; the article does not appear on the account's homepage and fans are not notified. To show it to fans, use "Mass Broadcasts". To edit a draft, go to the WeChat Official Account Platform.
wechatDraft.publishConfirm: After publishing, the article gets a permanent link but does not appear on the account's homepage and fans are not notified. To show it to fans, broadcast the draft under "Mass Broadcasts". Publish now?
wechatDraft.preview.tooltip: Opens a temporary link provided by WeChat to view the body and typesetting in the browser; the link expires shortly. The cover is shown only on the article card, not on the article page
wechatPublish.deleteConfirm: Delete? The published content will be removed from the WeChat Official Account and cannot be recovered!
wechatMenu.name: Menu name
wechatMenu.draftTip: Changes here take effect on the Official Account only after clicking "Publish menu"
wechatMenu.dirtyTip: There are unpublished changes; they take effect on the Official Account only after clicking "Publish menu"
wechatMenu.switchConfirm: Switching the account discards unpublished changes. Continue?
wechatMenu.selectTip: Select a menu on the left to edit
wechatMenu.conditionalTip: This account has {count} conditional menus; only the default menu can be edited here
wechatMenu.publishConfirm: Publishing overwrites the account's current menu. Publish now?
wechatMenu.deleteConfirm: All custom menus on the Official Account (including conditional menus) will be deleted immediately. Continue?
wechatFan.blacklistConfirm: Add the selected fans to the blacklist? Blacklisted fans will no longer receive messages from the Official Account.
wechatFan.unblacklistConfirm: Remove the selected fans from the blacklist?
wechatReply.type.tooltip: Keyword reply: sent when a fan's message matches a keyword; Subscribe reply: sent when a fan subscribes; Default reply: sent when a message arrives and no keyword matches
wechatReply.matchType.tooltip: Exact match: the message equals the keyword; Partial match: the message contains the keyword
wechatReply.mediaId.tooltip: MediaID of a permanent image material; see "Materials"
wechatQrcode.name: Name
wechatQrcode.name.tooltip: Purpose or channel label; shown only in this system and can be changed at any time
wechatQrcode.sceneId.tooltip: An integer from 1 to 4294967295; scan events carry this scene value. Leave blank to generate one automatically: the account's largest registered scene value plus one
wechatQrcode.sceneStr.tooltip: 1 to 64 characters; scan events carry this scene value
wechatQrcode.deleteConfirm: Delete? Only the record in this system is removed; the QR code on the WeChat side cannot be revoked, and permanent QR codes still count toward the creation limit.
wechatTemplate.title: Template title
wechatTemplate.openids.tooltip: Pick recipients from the fan list, up to 100 per send
wechatTemplate.url.tooltip: Web page opened when the template message is tapped; optional
wechatTemplate.appid.tooltip: Mini Program opened when the template message is tapped; must be linked to the Official Account and takes priority over the link URL; optional
wechatTemplate.pagePath.tooltip: Page path inside the Mini Program, parameters allowed, e.g. index?foo=bar; requires the Mini Program AppID
wechatTemplate.subscriptionTip: Template messages are a service account feature; subscription accounts cannot send them
wechatTemplate.deleteConfirm: Delete this template? It will be removed from the WeChat Official Account and cannot be recovered!
wechatTemplate.pickFans.tip: WeChat does not provide fan nicknames or avatars. Set remarks or tags under "Fans" first, then filter by tag and identify fans by remark.
wechatTemplateLog.title: Template title
wechatMass.mediaId.tooltip: Select the article to broadcast from Drafts. Cover, title, digest and typesetting are fixed in the draft and cannot be changed when broadcasting: push an article under "Article" first to create a draft (the cover can be chosen and the title and digest edited and previewed during the push), or edit the draft on the WeChat Official Account Platform
wechatMass.ignoreReprint.tooltip: WeChat runs an originality check when broadcasting articles. When checked, the broadcast continues if the article is judged a reprint and the original author allows reprints; when unchecked, the broadcast stops
wechatMass.preview.tooltip: Sends a preview message to the given fan OpenID so you can check the layout on a phone. Previews do not consume broadcast quota; the preview API is limited to 100 calls per day
wechatMass.previewOpenid: Fan OpenID to receive the preview
wechatMass.previewSuccess: Preview sent; check it on your phone
wechatMass.quota.service: Service account: {used} / {limit} all-fan broadcasts this month (tag-based broadcasts can be sent multiple times; each fan receives at most 4 broadcasts per month)
wechatMass.quota.tip: The quota is estimated by this system: broadcasts sent from the WeChat Official Account Platform website also consume it but cannot be counted here; the result returned by WeChat prevails (45028 means the quota is used up). Mass broadcasts require a verified Official Account.
wechatMass.sendConfirm: Submit this mass broadcast? Quota is limited (subscription accounts: 1 per day; service accounts: 4 all-fan broadcasts per month). It cannot be cancelled once submitted, and revoking does not refund quota.
wechatMass.sendSubmitted: Broadcast submitted; the final result depends on the WeChat callback or a status refresh
wechatMass.revokeConfirm: Revoke? The article page will become invalid (all broadcasts using the same draft become invalid too); fans who already received it can still see the message card, and used quota is not refunded.
wechatTag.name: Tag name
wechatTag.deleteConfirm: Delete this tag? It will also be removed from all fans that have it.
